mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for FEDFUNDS decline falls below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window or average 20-day return in declining rate periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals a labor market slowdown that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Average 20-day return when UNRATE > 4.5% is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC for UNRATE > 4.5% falls below 0.03 in any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate robust consumer demand and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through improved corporate revenue outlooks.
failure_condition: Interaction effect fails to produce positive returns in >40% of instances where both series rise by ≥0.5% MoM or Rank IC for interaction term falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle characterized by FEDFUNDS above 4.5% and rising, higher borrowing costs suppress corporate investment and consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Average 20-day return during FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and rising periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) reflects strong manufacturing activity and economic growth, which boosts corporate profits and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for INDPRO growth falls below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window or average 60-day return in INDPRO growth periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the core inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.5%, it signals persistent inflationary pressures that prompt central bank tightening, reducing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Average 5-day return when CPIAUCSL > 3.5% is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC for CPIAUCSL > 3.5% falls below 0.03 in any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) and declining unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicate a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer confidence and spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Interaction effect fails to produce positive returns in >40% of instances where PAYEMS rises ≥0.3% and UNRATE falls ≥0.1% MoM or Rank IC for interaction term falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion marked by strong GDP growth (GDPC1 > 2% annualized) and declining housing starts (HOUST falling), the economy approaches overheating, triggering policy tightening and profit-taking that cause negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Average 5-day return during late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 > 2% and HOUST falling) is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC for regime condition falls below 0.03 in any 3-year window.
